title: 第816章 未知岛屿第815章 逃生
slug: 重生之为蚁第816章未知岛屿
content_zh:
哗啦啦啦……
大海中，孙云等人驾驶着帆船，小心翼翼地行驶着。
至于客船上的人，应该大多都死了，肯定也会有不少人逃离的。毕竟，客船经常出海，自然会准备一些备用的小型船，不会都被海盗抢走。
海盗们的抢劫很匆忙，也不会每一个角落都搜查，有些漏网之鱼很正常。反正孙云是看到，他们离开的时候，最起码有五六艘小型船在逃离。
“胡兄，咱们这是去哪？”
孙云问旁边的大胡子老胡。
老胡是唯一有空间装备的，自然要拉拢一些心腹，不然会被其他人抢的。而孙云和丽娜，收集了不少食物和水，而且对大胡子老胡言听计从，成为了大胡子的临时心腹。
而擅长驾驶的水手，也拉拢了两个水手，形成了一股小势力。而光明教廷的两个人，与另外两个水手走得很近，算是船上最强的战斗力。
而真正服从老胡的，只有那位颇为强壮的水手，还是老胡的一个表弟。
“我们食物不多，而且大海中太危险，所以要赶紧找岛屿。我跟老刘商量过了，这个方向好像有岛屿，应该快要到了！”老胡认真地回答道。
这些人，表面上是听老胡的，但私下里已经串通了，老胡自然心里有数。倒是不被老胡看好的孙云，一直在支持他，帮他震慑其他人。
当然，孙云之所以让老胡信任，自然是孙云本身有一定的食物。最起码，孙云和丽娜两人，短时间不会因为食物来抢自己。
“岛大不大，有没有危险？”
孙云认真地问道。
未知的岛屿，不知道会有什么，上去会很危险地。毕竟，这里可是大海，人类不占据优势，可以说是一些未知魔兽和海兽的猎物。
“岛屿不小，有没有危险不知道，但树木茂密，有魔兽是肯定的。不管有没有危险，我们也必须过去暂避，不然其他人会撕了咱们的！”老胡有些不确定的回答道。
老顾的东西，其实已经分给大家一些了，勉强够大家维持几天的。可是，一旦他们消耗完了，必然会打老胡的主意，老顾自然不能把老本都扔出去。
所以，只有登上岛屿，这些人才会转移注意力。以这些人的实力，打猎一些小型魔兽食用，自然能解决食物问题。至于有没有生命危险，老顾自然就不用操心了，消耗掉几个人也没什么。
“可以，我们答应保护你，希望你也不要抛弃我俩。你放心，就算是我俩饿死，也不会抢你东西的！”孙云看着老胡，认真地说道。
虽然，这老胡只是七阶中期实力，但海上生存经验丰富。孙云和丽娜，现在必须依靠老胡才有可能安全逃离。尤其是丽娜，对大海比较排斥，现在才勉强适应了一些。

“可以，我们抱团生存！”
老胡愣了一下，认真地回答道。
通过接触，老胡自然能看出来，丽娜是孙云的手下。能有七阶巅峰高手做手下，而且时时刻刻都那么镇定，他认为孙云绝对不是一般人。
老胡如果能逃回去，必然会受到追究，他得为自己留条退路。而带着家人投奔孙云，也确实是一个不错的选择，他自然不会抛弃孙云了。
“岛，那边有一个岛屿！”
content_en:
Blah blah blah...
In the sea, Sun Yun and others drove the sailboat carefully.
As for the people on the passenger ship, most of them are probably dead, and many people will definitely escape. After all, passenger ships often go to sea, so they will naturally prepare some spare small ships so that they will not all be snatched away by pirates.
Pirates rob in a hurry and don't search every corner. It's normal for some fish to slip through. Anyway, Sun Yun saw that when they left, there were at least five or six small boats fleeing.
"Brother Hu, where are we going?"
Sun Yun asked the bearded old Hu next to him.
Lao Hu is the only one with space equipment, so he naturally has to win over some confidants, otherwise he will be robbed by others. Sun Yun and Lina collected a lot of food and water, and obeyed the bearded old nonsense, becoming his temporary confidants.
The sailor who was good at driving also attracted two sailors to form a small force. The two people from the Holy See of Light were very close to the other two sailors and were considered the strongest combatants on the ship.
The only person who really obeyed Lao Hu was the rather strong sailor, who was also a cousin of Lao Hu.
"We don't have much food, and the sea is too dangerous, so we need to find an island quickly. I have discussed it with Lao Liu. There seems to be an island in this direction, and it should be there soon!" Lao Hu replied seriously.
These people, on the surface, listen to Lao Hu, but secretly they have colluded, and Lao Hu naturally knows it. However, Sun Yun, who was not favored by Lao Hu, has been supporting him and helping him scare others.
Of course, the reason why Sun Yun gained Lao Hu's trust was that Sun Yun himself had a certain amount of food. At the very least, Sun Yun and Lina will not compete with them for food in the short term.
"Is the island big? Is it dangerous?"
Sun Yun asked seriously.
It’s an unknown island, I don’t know what’s going to happen, and it will be very dangerous to go up there. After all, this is the sea, and humans do not have an advantage. It can be said that they are the prey of some unknown monsters and sea beasts.
"The island is not small. I don't know if there is any danger, but the trees are dense and there are monsters for sure. Regardless of whether there is danger or not, we must go there and take shelter, otherwise others will tear us apart!" Lao Hu replied with some uncertainty.
In fact, some of Lao Gu's things have been distributed to everyone, which is barely enough for everyone to last for a few days. However, once they run out of money, they will definitely take advantage of Lao Hu, and Lao Gu naturally cannot throw away all their money.
Therefore, only by landing on the island will these people divert their attention. With the strength of these people, hunting some small monsters for food can naturally solve the food problem. As for whether his life is in danger, Lao Gu naturally doesn't have to worry about it. It doesn't matter if he consumes a few people.
"Okay, we promise to protect you, and I hope you won't abandon us. Don't worry, even if we starve to death, we won't steal your things!" Sun Yun looked at Lao Hu and said seriously.
Although Lao Hu is only at the mid-seventh level, he has rich experience in surviving at sea. Sun Yun and Lina now have to rely on Lao Hu to escape safely. Lina, in particular, was quite repelled by the sea, and now she has barely adapted to it.
"Okay, let's stay together as a team!"
Lao Hu was stunned for a moment and answered seriously.
Through contact, Lao Hu could naturally tell that Lina was Sun Yun's subordinate. To have a seventh-level peak master as his subordinate, and to be so calm at all times, he believed that Sun Yun was definitely not an ordinary person.
If Lao Hu can escape back, he will definitely be held accountable, and he must leave a way out for himself. Taking his family to join Sun Yun was indeed a good choice. Naturally, he would not abandon Sun Yun.
"Island, there is an island over there!"
